0022600037.text: The Atlanta Hawks (7-5, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-9, 14th in the East) for the Hawks' 13th game of the season, with Atlanta coming off a loss and sitting at 5-5 over its last ten while Chicago has dropped eight straight. Atlanta is without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), while Chicago is missing Dailyn Swain (back), Norman Powell (shoulder inflammation) and Tobe Awaka (back), and Caleb Wilson is day-to-day with a hand injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Hawks lost all three meetings last season, most recently a 126-123 loss in Atlanta on December 23, 2025, in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup.
